steps.text: Sign in to continue to your account

steps.note: a label at 140,140 pinned to 360 wide, sitting on one line: its right edge is the vertical line at x 500, and the whole box is under 40 points tall, so it wears four corner squares and no square in the middle of either side

the right edge taken halfway down, well clear of both corners, and pulled in to 250. The drag line above must say the cursor while down was resize-left-right, and the label must still start at x 140 and now be about 110 wide with the words wrapped onto more lines and a taller H. If X moved instead, the press slid the label across the canvas, which is the bug this walk exists for

the same label taken by its middle, 180 points in from either side: the drag line above must say the cursor was a plain arrow, X must have travelled to about 240 and W must still be 360. Grabbing a side sets the width the words wrap at, grabbing the middle moves the label, and the two never swap
